name: Text Diff
summary: Compare two texts side-by-side and highlight additions and deletions — entirely in your browser.
description: Paste original and modified text to see a line-based side-by-side diff with counts for additions, deletions, and unchanged lines. Export a unified diff to the clipboard. Nothing leaves your device.

faqs.question: Is this character-level or line-level?
faqs.answer: Line-level. Each changed line is highlighted as a deletion on the left and/or addition on the right.

faqs.question: Does my text get uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Diffing runs entirely in your browser.

faqs.question: What is the unified diff copy?
faqs.answer: A classic +/- format you can paste into chats, tickets, or patches.
